series.name: monthly mean 2 m air temperature, Frankfurt am Main (NASA POWER, 50.11 N, 8.68 E)

baselines.method: seasonal naive (value 12 months earlier); intervals from seasonal-lag residual sd widened by number of seasonal cycles

candidates.method: seasonal ARIMA(p,d,q)(P,D,Q)[12], orders chosen by AICc on the training window (p,q<=3; P,Q<=2; d,D in {0,1}), drift if d+D=1
linear trend plus K annual harmonics (K chosen by AICc, 1 to 4), OLS, normal prediction intervals

diagnostics.name: kpss_level
diagnostics.test: KPSS (level) on the seasonally adjusted training series, sample end 2022-12

diagnostics.name: adf_seasonally_adjusted
diagnostics.test: ADF (constant, lag by AIC) on the seasonally adjusted training series, sample end 2022-12

diagnostics.name: mann_kendall_annual
diagnostics.test: Mann-Kendall with Sen's slope on annual means of the training years 1981 to 2022; autocorrelation-corrected variant reported alongside

evaluation.supplementary: rolling origin inside the training window (annual origins 2000-12 to 2019-12, 36-month horizon) for model choice and horizon/season skill
evaluation.comparison: Diebold-Mariano with Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold correction against seasonal_naive; hold-out interval coverage reported per model
evaluation.mase_scale: in-sample MAE of seasonal naive (lag 12) on 1981-01 to 2022-12
